summary: Phase 1 Employment Classes tested end-to-end. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass (catalog, permissions, admin config GET/PUT/reset/stats, employees CRUD with employment_class, RBAC 403 for regular employee). Frontend: /app/employment-classes page fully functional (all 3 tabs, matrix switches, save, reset, workflows deep-link, sidebar entry role-gated). Employees page had TWO critical runtime crashes that I fixed as simple coding bugs. After fix all frontend expectations validated — deep-link filter, badge counts per class (4 interns, 3 consultants, 2 contractors, 35 on-roll, 44 total), role-gating.

minor.issue: Seeded on_roll count observed 34, PRD expected ~42 — likely older employees with no employment_class field plus TEST_* rows. Counts still meet >=3 per off-roll class; not blocking.

fixed_by_testing_agent.fix: Added missing useState for employmentClass/setEmploymentClass (page was crashing with ReferenceError: employmentClass is not defined). Added URL param parser so deep-link ?employment_class=X initializes the filter. Wired employment_class into GET /employees query params and into useEffect deps.
Added missing EMP_CLASS_LABELS lookup object (page was crashing with ReferenceError: EMP_CLASS_LABELS is not defined when rendering TableView/CardsView).
Added data-testid={emp-class-${id}} to Class badge in CardsView (was only present in TableView).

action_items: Main agent: review the 3 fixes applied to /app/frontend/src/pages/Employees.jsx — they were missing state declaration (useState for employmentClass), missing EMP_CLASS_LABELS constant, and missing data-testid on cards-view badge. These caused a full page crash. Recommend adding an error boundary around Employees to prevent similar regressions.
Optionally: run the seed_employment_classes.py again or migrate older demo employees so on_roll count matches the documented ~42.
critical_code_review_comments: Employees.jsx shipped with two undefined identifiers (employmentClass, EMP_CLASS_LABELS) — page was 100% broken on load. Indicates the Phase 1 feature never rendered in the browser before submission. Add a basic smoke test (component render) for pages added in each phase.

Frontend filter was declared in JSX but neither read from URL, stored in state, nor passed to the API — now fixed. Consider centralising class→label→colour map into /app/frontend/src/constants (already has a similar EMP_CLASS_LABELS implied) to avoid re-declaration.
employment_class_policy._normalize silently drops unknown classes and coerces missing keys — good. Consider also validating FEATURE_KEYS in incoming payload to detect FE drift early.

success_rate.frontend: 100% after 3 fixes applied by testing agent

context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 1 Employment Classes is functional after testing-agent patched Employees.jsx (3 coding bugs). All 12 pytest tests in /app/backend/tests/test_phase1_employment_class_api.py pass. Frontend flow verified end-to-end at preview URL. Counts from seed: 35 on_roll / 3 off_roll_consultant / 2 off_roll_contractor / 4 intern = 44 active. If retesting, start with the 12 pytest tests, then validate /app/employment-classes and /app/employees?employment_class=intern in browser.
rca of the issue: Employees.jsx crash RCA: JSX at line 83 referenced `employmentClass` and `setEmploymentClass` without a corresponding `useState` hook, and lines 138+184 used an `EMP_CLASS_LABELS` object that was never imported or declared in the file. Both are pure JS ReferenceErrors surfaced on first render, propagating to React's dev overlay. Reproduction: login hr@acme.io → navigate /app/employees → red overlay. Fix: added `const [employmentClass, setEmploymentClass] = useState(URLSearchParams→ 'all')`, wired it into load() params + useEffect deps, and declared a module-level `EMP_CLASS_LABELS` mapping. Validated via Playwright: deep-link filter shows 4 Intern rows, Consultant switch shows 3 Consultant rows, All shows 44.
